review.note: Reinstated in M44b. The M41b retraction said this actor would need an event for the creation of EDP in 1976 or for the nationalisation of electricity. edp-created-1976 is the first of those and names it with the role institution. The retraction block is deleted (A11, rule 27) and its reason is copied verbatim into docs/m44-retractions.md under Reinstated, in the same commit, so the account of the withdrawal survives the undoing of it.
